QuestInfo.name: A Gift for Camila
QuestInfo.0: #bUtah#k, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, is in need of help. Go talk to Utah.
QuestInfo.1: Utah wants give some gloves and a bandana to Camila. Defeat #rOfficial Knight Cs#k and #rOfficial Knight Ds#k to get the materials.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the gloves and bandana for Utah. He was happy and hopes Camila can smile again like she did in the old days.

0.0: You actually defeated Cygnus! I can't thank you enough for all you've done for us. Slowly, broken families will reform, and Maple World will return to normal.

yes.0: I thought hard about what to give Camila. My idea is a pair of gloves for delicate hands, and a bandana for her gorgeous hair.
yes.1: I will need some samples and materials to make the gifts. Luckily, Cygnus Knights should carry both!
yes.2: Please get #b30 Knight Gloves#k from #rOfficial Knight Ds#k and #b30 Knight Bandanas#k from #rOfficial Knight Cs#k. Good luck!

no.0: Ah. Well, that's the way it goes. You must have a lot of important things to do...

0.1: By the way... are you busy? If not, I have a favor to ask. Camila's done a lot for me, and I want to give her a gift. But the gift I have in mind is... hard to come by. Could you help me?

1.0: Did you get the gloves and bandana?

yes.0: It'd be great to see Camila smile again.

item.0: Please get #b30 Knight Gloves#k from #rOfficial Knight Ds#k and #b30 Knight Bandanas#k from #rOfficial Knight Cs#k. Good luck!
